objective: Turn a local verified fixture bundle into an explainable operator screening queue.

commands.command: uv run --python 3.11 --with pytest --with ruff python -m pytest -q
uv run --python 3.11 --with pytest --with ruff python scripts\validate.py
commands.result: test suite, compile, Ruff, and 3 verified bundles passed

commands.command: uv run --python 3.11 --with pytest --with ruff ruff check src tests scripts
uv run --python 3.11 python -m athena_procurement_arena screen-bundle --bundle scenarios\fixtures\verified\gt-003-morgan-hill.json (and gt-007, gt-008)
commands.result: All three real verified bundles emitted machine-readable screens

behavior: Emits every fixture, including current, held, rejected, and non-current records.
Includes source provenance, lifecycle, disposition, reason codes, and deterministic next action.
Preserves the existing shortlist and qualification semantics.
Introduces no network, discovery, outreach, submission, or execution authority.
evidence_limits: The current verified bundles are all non-current or otherwise held; this does not create a live opportunity.
No historical or prospective sealed holdout was added, so no real-world accuracy or promotion claim is made.
Changes are local and uncommitted; no push, merge, deployment, or external action was performed.
repair: Reordered deterministic next-action precedence so aggregate/rating-only capacity maps to per-project capacity verification.
